title: GTA 6 PS5 File Size Confirmed to Be 212GB, Physical Map Available But Not in Boxed Copies
text: GTA 6 PS5 File Size Confirmed to Be 212GB, Physical Map Available But Not in Boxed Copies | Push Square Menu Search Share Guest Guest Login | Sign Up Push Square News Reviews Features Videos Games PS Plus Guides Forums Search Keywords Guest Login or Sign Up Home Choose Topics... Manage Topics News Rockstar Games PS5 Grand Theft Auto GTA GTA 6 PS5 File Size Confirmed to Be 212GB, Physical Map Available But Not in Boxed Copies Preload brought forward two days by Liam Croft 6 hours ago Share: Rockstar Games has today shared more details on the launch of GTA 6 , across both its digital and physical versions on PS5. Rumoured last week via a social media account, it has now been confirmed that GTA 6 requires 212GB of space to be downloaded and installed. You'll be able to preload the game, and that option has actually been brought forward by two days. GTA 6 preload will now be available from Tuesday, 10th November 2026. The title then releases for PS5 and Xbox Series X|S on 19th November 2026. Further, a mainstay of past GTA physical editions, a map of the game world will be produced — but it won't come with the physical "code in a box" editions. Instead, it'll be purchasable for $0.99 from the official Rockstar Store, or bundled in for free with any purchase you make from the storefront — that's if you want a real physical version of it. Alternatively, there'll be a digital download of the GTA 6 boxart and the Leonida map, which I suppose you could just print out yourself. All the GTA 6 release info you need "On November 19 we will be adding an official printable Grand Theft Auto VI cover art poster and map of Leonida as a free digital download to the official site," Rockstar revealed. "A double-sided physical version of this poster will also be made available shortly after launch from the Rockstar Store — for $0.99 on its own or as a free gift with any purchase from the Rockstar Store." For more information on the release, check out our GTA 6 Release Times and Preload guide through the link. Will you be grabbing that physical map? Let us know in the comments below.
